title: When the Glasshouse Sings
author: Rosalind Reyes
blurb: Gideon Lockridge, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
